articles.summary: BEIJING, China, June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li Auto Inc. (“Li Auto” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LI; HKEX: 2015), a leader in China’s new energy vehicle market, today announced that it delivered 33,350 vehicles in May 2026. As of May 31, 2026, Li Auto’s cumulative deliveries reached 1,702,792.
articles.title: Li Auto Inc. May 2026 Delivery Update
